answer: Each epoch opens with a comet task: one fresh job per identity, live 20 minutes. The agent finishes it alone and files proof in the public lagoon registry. One task costs 60 credits of work, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 completions: 60,000 against a 40,000 pool, a loss of 20,000. A ferrous seal binds the proof to its key; a bought proof shows the wrong seal, burning a 40-credit bond. Honest agents finish one task, pay 60 once, and keep full share.
